When traveling for work, what you really want for your Apple devices isn't a bunch of cables and adapters, but an accessory that can handle everything at once. There are plenty of options on the market, but they're usually pretty bulky. Anker's Prime Qi2 25W foldable 3-in-1 wireless charger is designed to solve this problem. It folds completely flat, weighs about the same as an iPhone 17 Pro Max, and can charge your iPhone, Apple Watch, and AirPods simultaneously.

MagSafe Monday: Every Monday, Bradley Chambers breaks down the latest news from the MagSafe and wireless charging industry, helping you get the most out of your wireless charging-compatible Apple devices.

Foldable 3-in-1 Charger

As the name suggests, the selling point of this product is that it's only palm-sized and can fold completely flat to slip into a pants pocket, backpack, or crossbody bag, taking up virtually no space. I've taken quite a few MagSafe stands on trips, and almost every time they're the bulkiest thing in my laptop bag.

Qi2 25W Charging Speed

It's Qi2.2 certified and delivers up to 25W of MagSafe charging power—much faster than the 7.5W ceiling that most MagSafe accessories have been stuck at for years. Anker claims it can charge an iPhone 17 Pro to 50% in 26 minutes, which is a whopping 5 times faster than a standard 5W wireless charger. Real-world performance will vary depending on your iPhone model and temperature, but even getting close to this level is pretty impressive.

Faster MagSafe charging usually means more heat, so Anker added what they call AirCool temperature control. It operates at only 19 decibels—quiet enough that you won't even notice it's running. The design keeps your phone below 98.6°F while maintaining the full 25W output. Heat is the common enemy of both battery life and charging speed, so if this feature actually delivers on its claims in everyday use, it's far more than a marketing gimmick—it's a genuine selling point.

This 3-in-1 design covers everything you need: the main MagSafe pad charges your iPhone, there's an MFi-certified Apple Watch charger on the side, and the charging pad at the bottom handles AirPods. The core value of this type of charging dock is simple: just one cable to the wall outlet, instead of three separate chargers with three separate cables crowding your space. The box includes:

  • Anker Prime Wireless Charging Dock
  • 45W USB-C Wall Charger
  • 5-foot USB-C to USB-C Cable

I really appreciate that Anker includes a wall charger in the box, since many similar products assume you already have a fast enough charger. It also supports 110V to 220V input, so you don't need to bring an extra voltage converter when traveling abroad.

Summary

Anker has released quite a few 3-in-1 chargers over the years, but the foldable design is what sets this one apart in a crowded market. It truly addresses the main reason most people don't want to bring a charging dock on the go: traditional designs simply don't fit in luggage. This one solves that problem.

You can buy the Anker Prime Qi2 25W Foldable 3-in-1 Wireless Charger directly from Amazon or the Anker website.
